tools.name: get_quote_checklist
tools.description: Use when someone wants quotes for building, repair or renovation work in the United States. Returns the details contractors need so you can ask the person for them.

tools.name: create_quote_request
tools.description: Use after the person confirms the job description and asks to get quotes from local contractors. Saves a draft and returns a private link. The person opens the link and gives an email for receiving bids. BidCraft emails them an invite to track the bids; once they click it, BidCraft contacts local co

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_quote_request · Private data: create_quote_request · Public sink: create_quote_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_quote_request · Private data: create_quote_request · Public sink: create_quote_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
